dedupe_keys.name: nisr rwanda fifth population and housing census 2022 main indicators workbook 101 sheets with private housing units by habitat type tenure and roof wall and floor material households by drinking water source toilet waste and sewage disposal electricity access lighting source reg grid private hydro mini grid solar generator and cooking energy by province and district

description: NISR, the national statistics institute of Rwanda, publishes the main indicators of the Fifth Population and Housing Census of August 2022 as an Excel workbook with 101 sheets alongside the main report. Housing sheets give private households by habitat type and tenure, and private housing units by the main material of the roof, walls and floor, by district. Service sheets cover drinking water sources, toilet facilities, waste disposal, sewage disposal, electricity access and cooking energy. The lighting table splits households between the national grid run by REG, private hydro mini-grids, solar power, generators or batteries and flashlights, as percentages by province and district; in the national row 47 percent use REG electricity and 13.9 percent solar. Further sheets cover internet use, mobile phones, energy saving stoves, farming and livestock, and population by sector. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration. Licence: the site footer states CC BY 4.0. Caveats: most housing tables are percentages, not counts, and the older www host name failed TLS name checks while the bare domain works. Simulation uses: grid, mini-grid and solar shares by district for electrification planning, and roof and wall materials for storm and landslide exposure. Related records: the Kigali building stock typology and the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids.
